title: VISIT: T-3 Know Before You Go
subject: Three days to the Badlands: what to know before you go
preheader: Your entry window, parking, what to bring and how to make a day of it.

props.html:
Hello [[FIRSTNAME OR "Friend"]],

In three days, on [[custom.acme_-_visit_date_text OR "your visit date"]], you will stand where a young Theodore Roosevelt rebuilt himself, on the buttes above the Little Missouri. Here is everything that makes the day go smoothly.
Welcome back, member. Use the member line at the entrance, and remember 25% off extra admission tickets and 10% off in the Library Shop and at Salt+Scoria.

Thinking about membership? Anyone at the front desk can refund these tickets and put what you paid toward a membership, and your reservation stays as it is. You can also email membership@trlibrary.com before you come with your order number ([[custom.acme_-_recent_order_id OR "on your ticket confirmation"]]).

Arrive up to 15 minutes before the time on your ticket, or any time within that hour. With a 10:00 AM ticket, come any time from 9:45 to 11:00 AM. Leave a few minutes for the walk from the lot and a quick security check.

props.note: Only service animals go inside; leashed dogs are welcome on the grounds. Never leave a pet in a parked car.
rows: Comfortable shoes and a layer for the wind
Bags larger than 12 × 12 × 6 inches (free lockers hold a day bag)
A water bottle with a sealed lid; refill stations inside
Pocket knives (staff will hold one for you); no weapons on site
A card or phone: the campus is cashless

props.html: Parking is free. Take the first roundabout into the main lot under the solar canopies. Driving an RV or towing? Use the Medora Musical lot instead. Accessible spaces and a drop-off sit right by the entrance, and EV chargers are first come, first served.

props.caption: Live from the National Weather Service. Tap for the full forecast.

props.html: Plan about three and a half hours for the galleries, then walk the one-mile boardwalk or the rooftop prairie. Many visitors pair the Library with the national park: drive the South Unit's scenic loop in the morning, when wildlife is most active, and spend the afternoon here. Salt+Scoria serves breakfast and lunch, and it is quieter before or after the noon rush.

props.html: Check the hours and, in winter, North Dakota road conditions before you leave. Need a wheelchair, help from the lot or anything arranged ahead? Write to hello@trlibrary.com.
